title: One Pot Chili Mac
steps: Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and soften both in oil over medium heat until translucent.
Add the ground beef and cook it until fully browned.
Sprinkle in the flour and spices and stir for about two minutes.
Pour in tomato sauce and beef broth, add dry macaroni, and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on medium-low until pasta is tender and liquid turns to a gravy.
Stir in half the cheddar, top with the rest, cover and let it melt off the heat.

title: Easy Old Fashioned Sloppy Joes
steps: Dice the onion and green pepper and mince the garlic.
Brown the beef in a skillet and pour off extra fat.
Add the vegetables and garlic and cook until softened.
Mix in tomato sauce, paste, vinegar, sugar, mustard, chili powder, Worcestershire and salt.
Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Toast the buns and spoon the meat sauce onto them.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Gently poach the chicken in milk, broth and stock powder, then shred it and save the liquid.
Melt butter and cook garlic and onion, then add thyme, carrot and celery.
Splash in wine and let it mostly cook off.
Stir in flour for a minute, then slowly whisk in poaching liquid, broth and parmesan.
Return chicken with peas and simmer until thick, then chill the filling.
Fill pots, cap with puff pastry, brush with egg and cut a small vent.
Bake at 180°C / 350°F until the pastry is deep golden.

title: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Bring water and most of the broth to a boil, whisk in grits, and simmer until thick.
Pat shrimp dry, toss with Cajun seasoning, and sear in hot oil about a minute per side.
In the same pan, soften the onion, then add garlic and sprinkle with flour.
Whisk in remaining broth, milk and hot sauce to make a quick pan sauce.
Slide the shrimp back in just to heat through.
Stir butter and cheddar into the grits, then top with shrimp, sauce and scallions.

title: Homemade Chicken and Dumplings
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in a deep skillet, then set them aside.
Cook onion and garlic, then add diced carrots and celery.
Melt butter in the pan, stir in flour, and cook the roux briefly.
Add herbs, broth and milk and simmer until the gravy thickens.
Dice the chicken, return it to the gravy, and keep it at a simmer.
Mix dumpling dry ingredients, then stir in milk and melted butter.
Drop 2-Tbsp spoonfuls on top, cover, and simmer until puffed; chicken should hit 165°F.

title: Slow Cooker Jambalaya
steps: Finely dice celery, onion and bell pepper, mince garlic, and put them in the slow cooker.
Layer sliced sausage, cubed chicken and the dried spices on top.
Pour over the canned tomatoes and broth, add parsley, and stir.
Cook on high.
Stir in the rice, making sure it is submerged, and cook until it absorbs the liquid.
Fluff gently and finish with sliced green onions.

title: Louisiana Style Red Beans and Rice with Sausage
steps: Soak the dry beans in water overnight, then drain.
Brown the sliced sausage in oil and set it aside.
Cook onion, pepper, celery and garlic, then stir in spices and bay leaves.
Add beans and fresh water, cover, and simmer.
Mash some beans against the pot and simmer uncovered to thicken.
Cook the rice separately while the beans finish.
Return sausage with parsley, salt to taste, and serve over rice with green onions.

title: Jamaican Rice and Peas Recipe
steps: Soak the dry beans at least two hours, or use a can of kidney beans instead.
Pressure cook beans with garlic, allspice, ginger and salt.
Add coconut milk, thyme, scallion, onion and the whole scotch bonnet; bring to a boil.
Stir in rinsed rice, return to a boil, then drop heat to low and steam until liquid is gone.
Rest a few minutes, then pull out thyme stems, pepper and ginger before serving.

title: Authentic and Delicious Picadillo Recipe
steps: Cook diced onion and red pepper in oil until soft, then add garlic.
Add ground beef with salt, sazon and adobo and brown it well.
Stir in the sofrito.
Add olives, raisins, vinegar, tomato sauce, bay leaves and water.
Simmer until the sauce thickens, then remove bay leaves.

title: Brazilian Feijoada (Pork and Black Bean Stew)
steps: Rinse the beans and cook with onion, garlic, bay leaves and salt until tender (stovetop or pressure cooker).
Crisp the bacon in a Dutch oven and set it aside.
Brown cubed pork in the drippings, then add sliced sausage.
Soften onion and garlic, then add tomatoes, bell pepper and cilantro.
Combine beans and their liquid with the meats, season, and simmer low until thick.
Make garlic butter rice: toast rice in garlic and butter, add broth, and simmer.
Serve the stew over the rice.

title: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Make or warm the enchilada sauce and shred the cooked chicken.
Stir chicken with cumin, garlic powder, salt, green chilies and ¾ cup cheese.
Heat oven to 350°F and warm tortillas so they roll without cracking.
Spread ½ cup sauce in a 9x13 dish, fill tortillas, roll and lay seam-side down.
Cover with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Bake at 350°F until the cheese melts and bubbles.

title: Poor Man's Burrito Bowls
steps: Bring rice, salt and water to a boil in a covered pot.
Drop heat to low and simmer covered, then rest 5 minutes and fluff.
Meanwhile warm undrained beans with cumin and garlic powder over medium, stirring often.
Slice the green onions and jalapeño.
Build bowls with rice, beans, salsa and cheese, then top with onions and jalapeño.

title: Crispy Baked Beef Tacos
steps: Stir the spices together for taco seasoning and heat the oven to 400°F.
Soften diced onion and garlic in oil.
Add beef and seasoning and cook until browned all the way through.
Stir in the well-drained black beans.
Stand shells upright in a baking dish, fill with beef mixture, and top with cheddar.
Bake at 400°F until cheese melts and shell edges brown, then add toppings.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Soften onion and garlic in oil.
Turn heat up and brown the beef, breaking it into small bits.
Pour in wine and let it bubble until the alcohol smell fades.
Add tomatoes, paste, bouillon, Worcestershire and herbs; simmer uncovered, stirring now and then.
Cook spaghetti in salted water while the sauce simmers.
Toss pasta with sauce briefly and finish with parmesan and parsley.

title: Aglio e Olio (Spaghetti with garlic olive oil)
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water for 1 minute less than the packet says.
Save a cup of pasta water, then drain.
Gently fry sliced garlic in olive oil over medium until pale golden, not brown.
Add chili flakes for about 30 seconds.
Add pasta, ½ cup reserved water and salt; toss over medium-high until glossy.
Toss in parsley and serve right away with parmesan.

title: Lasagna!
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic for the ragu base.
Brown the beef, then add tomatoes, paste, wine, bouillon, herbs and Worcestershire.
Simmer the ragu covered until the meat is very tender.
Uncover and keep simmering until thick.
For cheese sauce, cook butter and flour, whisk in milk until thick, then stir in cheese and nutmeg.
Layer ragu, pasta sheets and cheese sauce three times, finishing with sauce and mozzarella.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) until golden and bubbling.
Rest before cutting.

title: Tortilla Espanola: Spanish Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Fry potato slices in olive oil for a couple of minutes.
Add onion and cook, mashing lightly, until potatoes turn a little golden.
Pour eggs over so potatoes are covered; cook gently on low, shaking the pan.
Once mostly set, flip onto a plate and slide back in to cook the other side.
Rest, slice into wedges and garnish with olives.

title: Coq au Vin
steps: Marinate chicken with wine, onions and herbs overnight (12 to 24 hours).
Lift out chicken and onions, and boil the wine until reduced by half.
Pat chicken dry, season, and sear in oil until golden.
Brown bacon, then sauté mushrooms, then the onions, setting each aside.
Cook butter and garlic, then tomato paste, then flour, and slowly stir in stock and wine.
Return everything to the pot and braise covered in a 350°F (180°C) oven.
Adjust sauce thickness and salt; serve with mash or tagliatelle.

title: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Mix chicken with oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper; marinate at least 3 hours.
Grate and squeeze cucumber, then stir with yogurt, vinegar, lemon, garlic and oil; let sit.
Thread the chicken onto 8 skewers.
Cook over high heat about 3 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve with tzatziki, warm flatbreads, lettuce and tomato.

title: Easy Homemade Falafel
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas, then pulse with onion, herbs, garlic, salt, cayenne and cumin into a chunky paste.
Stir in baking powder, then add flour 2 tbsp at a time until the mix holds together.
Cover and chill so the flavors meld.
Shape into small patties using about 2 tbsp each.
Shallow-fry in hot shimmering oil over medium until deep golden and crisp on both sides.

title: Chinese Tomato Egg Stir-fry (番茄炒鸡蛋)
steps: Cut tomatoes into wedges, discarding stems, and finely chop the scallion.
Whisk eggs with a little salt, white pepper, sesame oil and Shaoxing wine.
Scramble eggs in 2 tbsp oil in a smoking-hot wok over medium heat, then set them aside.
Add remaining oil, turn heat to high and stir-fry tomatoes and scallion for a minute.
Add sugar, salt and water, return the eggs, cover and cook until tomatoes fully soften.
Uncover and stir-fry on high until the sauce thickens to your liking; serve over rice.

title: Kung Pao Chicken: An Authentic Chinese Recipe
steps: Toast peanuts in a teaspoon of oil over medium heat, stirring constantly, then let them cool.
Toss cubed chicken with oil, cornstarch, Shaoxing wine, salt and white pepper; let it marinate.
Stir together soy sauces, vinegar, sugar, water and cornstarch for the sauce.
Sear chicken in 2 tbsp oil over high heat, then move it to a bowl.
On low heat, cook garlic, ginger, chilies, peppercorn powder and scallions until fragrant.
Return chicken, raise heat to high and stir-fry briefly.
Stir the sauce, pour it in and cook until glossy and thick, then toss in the peanuts.

title: Mapo Tofu Recipe: The Real Deal
steps: Gently heat fresh and dried chilies in 1/4 cup oil to make a chili oil; set aside.
In the remaining oil, cook ginger for a minute, then add garlic.
Turn heat to high and brown the pork, breaking it up until fully cooked.
Stir in ground Sichuan peppercorns briefly without letting them scorch.
Add bean sauce and broth, simmer a minute, then thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Fold in the chili oil and tofu, tossing gently until heated through.
Finish with sesame oil, sugar and scallions, then dust with more peppercorn powder.

title: Oyakodon (Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl) 親子丼
steps: Stir together dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar for the simmering sauce.
Slice onion into strips, chop the greens, cut chicken into bite-size pieces and toss with sake.
Loosely break up eggs with chopsticks, leaving streaks of white.
Simmer onion in the sauce, add chicken and cook uncovered, flipping halfway.
Pour in two-thirds of the egg around the center and cook until just set.
Add the rest of the egg and greens, cook to your liking and slide over rice with sauce.

title: Tonkatsu (Japanese Pork Cutlet)
steps: Grind sesame seeds and mix into bowls of tonkatsu sauce for dipping.
Trim fat, nick the connective tissue, pound the pork and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 cups oil in a deep pot to 340°F (170°C).
Coat cutlets in flour, then egg mixed with oil, then panko; rest them.
Fry each cutlet about a minute per side, then drain on a rack.
Raise oil to 355°F (180°C) and refry briefly per side; pork should reach 145°F.
Rest, slice into strips and serve with shredded cabbage and sauce.

title: Korean Bulgogi Beef Stir Fry
steps: Pat the sliced beef dry and put it in a bowl.
Mix soy, sugar, mirin, sesame oil, grated onion, garlic, apple and ginger; coat beef and chill.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and cook onion and scallion whites.
Add beef with its marinade plus carrots and stir-fry constantly until cooked.
Toss with sesame seeds, top with scallion greens and serve with rice.

title: Japchae (Chap Chae)
steps: Boil sweet potato noodles, drain, rinse and cut into roughly 6-inch lengths.
Blanch spinach until wilted, squeeze out water and cut in half.
Mix soy sauce and sugar for the sauce.
Stir-fry garlic, onion, mushrooms and carrot, then add scallion.
Lower the heat and toss in noodles, spinach, sesame oil, sauce and salt to taste.
Serve at room temperature sprinkled with sesame seeds.

title: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in boiling water, drain and rinse under cold water.
Stir together tamarind, brown sugar, fish sauce and oyster sauce.
In hot oil over high heat, briefly cook garlic and onion, then add sliced chicken.
Push chicken to one side, scramble eggs in the gap, then combine.
Add sprouts, tofu, noodles and sauce and toss gently until coated.
Toss in garlic chives and half the peanuts; serve with lime, chili and remaining peanuts.

title: Authentic Thai Basil Chicken Recipe (ผัดกระเพราไก่)
steps: Fry the egg in hot oil, spooning oil over the top until crispy; set aside.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and pound garlic with chilies.
Stir-fry garlic and chilies in a hot wok until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir-fry until nearly cooked through.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauces and sugar and stir-fry briefly.
Toss in basil, take off the heat and serve over rice with the egg.

title: Vietnamese Noodles with Lemongrass Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in lemongrass, garlic, lime, fish sauce, soy, brown sugar and oil.
Mix the nuoc cham sauce ingredients and let it sit so the sugar dissolves.
Pan-fry chicken over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Rest the chicken, then slice it.
Soak vermicelli in hot water, drain and rinse cold.
Build bowls with noodles, vegetables, herbs and chicken; drizzle with sauce and add lime.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
steps: Stir yogurt, lemon, ginger, garlic and spices together, coat the chicken and chill at least 3 hours.
Melt ghee in a large pan over high heat and cook the chicken until the outside turns white.
Add passata, cream, sugar, salt and any leftover marinade, then simmer on low until thick.
Taste for salt, scatter cilantro and serve over basmati rice.

title: Dal Tadka Recipe (Restaurant Style)

amounts.Lentils: 1 cup (200g) mixed toor, moong and chana dal
amounts.Garlic: 1 tsp chopped, plus 1/2 to 1 tbsp for tadka

steps: Rinse the dal well and pressure cook with 3 cups water for 3 to 4 whistles until soft.
Fry cumin in oil, then garlic, ginger, onion and green chili until the onion softens.
Add turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, tomatoes and salt; cook until tomatoes break down.
Stir in the cooked dal and simmer, then add kasuri methi and coriander.
For the tadka, heat ghee and fry cumin, mustard seeds, dried chilies, garlic, asafoetida and chili powder.
Pour the sizzling tadka over the dal and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Chana Masala (using raw chickpeas)

amounts.Chickpeas: 1 cup raw (200g), soaked overnight, or 2.5 cups canned

steps: Soak chickpeas overnight, then pressure cook with salt and water until tender (skip if using canned).
Crush ginger, garlic and green chili into a rough paste.
Toast the whole spices in hot oil until fragrant, then soften the onion with a pinch of salt.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell is gone.
Stir in pureed tomato and tomato paste and simmer.
Add ground spices for 30 seconds, then the chickpeas and water; simmer on medium-low.
Finish with crushed kasuri methi and cilantro and serve hot.

title: Shakshuka Recipe (Easy and Authentic)
steps: Sauté onion, peppers, garlic and spices in olive oil until softened.
Add chopped tomatoes and tomato sauce, cover and simmer, then uncover to thicken.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook over medium-low until the whites are set.
Top with parsley and mint and serve with bread.

title: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Mix the shawarma spice blend in a small bowl.
Pat chicken dry, salt it and cut into bite-size pieces.
Toss chicken with spices, onion, lemon juice and olive oil; marinate up to 3 hours or overnight if time allows.
Heat oven to 425°F and spread chicken and onions in one layer on an oiled sheet pan.
Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F internally; broil briefly for crisp edges if you like.
Fill pitas with sauce, chicken, arugula, salad and pickles and serve right away.

title: Authentic Mujadara (Middle Eastern Lentils, Rice and Onions)

amounts.Rice: 1 cup long-grain white rice, soaked and drained
amounts.Onion: 2 large diced (4 cups), plus 1 large thinly sliced for garnish

steps: Par-cook the lentils in 2 cups water, then drain.
Slowly caramelize the diced onions in olive oil over medium-high heat until deep brown.
Add 2 cups water to the onions, then stir in the rice, lentils, salt, pepper and cumin.
Cover and cook on low until the liquid is absorbed.
Meanwhile fry the sliced onion in olive oil until crisp and golden.
Rest the pot, then top with crispy onions and parsley.

title: Misir Wat Recipe (Ethiopian Spicy Red Lentils)
steps: Soften the onions in oil or niter kibbeh in a large pan.
Add garlic and ginger and cook briefly.
Stir in tomato paste, berbere, black pepper, nigella and cardamom and toast for a minute.
Add lentils, broth and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until lentils are tender.
Rest for extra flavor if you have time, then garnish with cilantro.

title: Doro Wat Recipe (Ethiopian Chicken Stew)

amounts.Chicken thighs: 2 lbs thighs and legs, skin removed

steps: Soak the chicken in lemon water, then drain and rinse.
Cook the chopped onions in a dry pot, stirring, until soft and caramelized.
Add oil, garlic, ginger, berbere, paprika, salt and pepper and cook until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and cook to deepen the color.
Pour in water or stock, bring to a boil, add the chicken and simmer on low.
Stir in niter kibbeh and the peeled eggs and simmer a little longer.
Serve with injera or rice, plus parsley and lemon.

title: Shepherd's Pie

amounts.Butter: 2 tbsp for mash, plus 2 tbsp melted for topping

steps: Sauté onion, garlic, carrot, celery and dried herbs in oil until soft.
Turn heat to high and brown the ground lamb.
Add flour, tomato paste, stock, wine, bouillon, Worcestershire and bay leaves; simmer until thick.
Season, move to a baking dish, stir in peas and let it cool so the mash sits on top.
Boil potatoes until soft, then mash with butter and milk.
Spread the mash over the filling, rough it up with a fork, add parmesan and melted butter.
Bake at 180°C until golden on top.

title: Toad in the Hole

amounts.Flour: 1 cup plain flour, plus 3 tbsp for gravy

steps: Whisk eggs, flour, milk, water, mayo, salt and pepper into a batter and chill it.
Heat oven to 220°C and heat the drippings in the baking pan until smoking hot.
Brown the sausages on the stovetop, leaving one side lightly colored.
Pour the cold batter around the sausages in the hot pan and bake on the top shelf until puffed and golden; do not open the oven.
For gravy, cook onion wedges until deep brown, add garlic and flour, then whisk in stock and Worcestershire.
Simmer gravy until thick and serve straight away with the toad in the hole.

title: Easy Hamburger Soup
steps: Brown the ground beef with the onion and garlic, then drain off the fat.
Stir in potatoes, broth, tomatoes, tomato soup, Worcestershire, Italian seasoning and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer.
Add the frozen vegetables and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

title: Homemade Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni according to the package, then drain and set it aside.
Melt butter with flour in a pot over medium heat and whisk until bubbly.
Whisk in milk in batches and simmer until it is as thick as heavy cream.
Turn off the heat and stir in onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper and hot sauce.
Whisk in the cheese a handful at a time until it melts.
Fold the cooked macaroni into the cheese sauce and serve.

title: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in oil over medium-high heat until the onion is translucent.
Add garlic, parsley and thyme and cook briefly.
Add broth, whole chicken breasts, rice, salt and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot, and stir in cream if using.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Sauté zucchini and green onions with lemon pepper, then spread them in a casserole dish.
Dredge the chicken in flour mixed with lemon pepper, then brown both sides.
Set the chicken on top of the zucchini.
Whisk broth, wine, lemon juice, flour and garlic powder in the skillet and simmer, scraping up browned bits.
Spoon the sauce over the chicken and bake covered.
Uncover and bake until the chicken reaches 165°F.

title: Cheesy Potato Soup

amounts.Potatoes: 1 lb baking potatoes, cut into 2" pieces

steps: Bring broth, pepper and mustard powder to a boil, add the potatoes, and simmer until fork-tender.
Lightly mash the potatoes in the pot.
In another pan, melt butter with garlic, stir in flour, and cook briefly.
Whisk in milk and boil until thick and bubbly.
Off the heat, stir in cream cheese and onion powder, then the shredded cheeses until melted.
Combine the cheese sauce with the potatoes, thin with broth as needed, and simmer briefly.

title: Hearty Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Mix beans, corn, onion, garlic, cilantro, cheese and taco seasoning in a bowl.
Spread ½ cup filling on half of each tortilla and fold it over.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat until both sides are golden and crisp.
Cut into triangles and serve with sour cream or salsa.

title: Enfrijoladas – Tortillas in Black Bean Sauce
steps: Blend beans, chipotles with adobo, some diced onion, cumin and garlic powder, adding broth until the sauce is smooth.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Warm the tortillas and keep them covered.
Dice the remaining onion and toss it with chopped cilantro and a pinch of salt.
Dip each tortilla in sauce, add a little cheese and onion mix, fold into triangles, and place in a dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the tortillas and bake until heated through.
Top with the rest of the cheese and onion mix and serve.

title: Chipotle Chicken Tacos
steps: Simmer chicken in about 4 cups water with half the garlic and onion, the bay leaf, peppercorns and salt, until it reaches 160°F.
Remove the chicken, save the broth, and shred the meat with forks.
Sauté the remaining onion and garlic in oil.
Add chopped chipotles, the shredded chicken and ¼ cup reserved broth, and heat through.
Optional: chop and mix pineapple, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice and salt for a salsa.
Fill each tortilla with ¼ cup chicken and top with salsa.

title: Simple Sopa de Fideo (Mexican Noodle Soup)
steps: Break up the noodles and toast them in oil over medium-low heat until golden.
Add onion, garlic and cumin and cook until softened.
Pour in the tomato juice, then blend the tomatoes and add them to the pot.
Add broth and a whole jalapeño and bring to a boil.
Simmer until the noodles are tender.
Stir in lime juice and cilantro and serve right away.

title: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp and set half of it aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, celery, garlic, oregano, pepper flakes, salt and pepper.
Add beans, tomatoes, water and broth, bring to a boil, then simmer.
Stir in the pasta and cook, stirring often, until tender.
Off the heat, stir in Parmesan and parsley; thin with broth if needed.
Serve topped with the reserved bacon.

title: Penne all'Arrabbiata (Spicy Tomato Pasta)
steps: Cook garlic in oil briefly, then add fresh chilli and chilli flakes and cook until the garlic is light golden.
Add tomatoes, salt, pepper and a can-rinse of water, and simmer until thickened.
Meanwhile, boil the pasta in salted water and save 1 cup of the cooking water.
Toss the drained pasta in the sauce with ½ cup pasta water until coated.
Serve topped with Parmesan and parsley.

title: Bacon and Spinach Pasta with Parmesan
steps: Fry bacon pieces until crisp, then remove them, leaving about 1 tablespoon fat.
Sauté the diced onion in the bacon fat until soft.
Add broth and scrape up the browned bits.
Add the dry pasta, cover, boil, then simmer on low, stirring often.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Off the heat, add the bacon and Parmesan, stir, and serve.

title: Spicy Chilli Prawn Pasta (Shrimp)
steps: Boil the pasta one minute short of the package time and save a mug of pasta water.
Sear the shrimp in hot oil until the outside turns opaque.
Add chilli flakes and anchovies, then the wine and garlic, and cook until the wine mostly evaporates.
Stir in passata, lemon juice, Parmesan, salt and pepper and simmer.
Add the pasta, ½ cup pasta water and parsley, and toss until the sauce coats it.

title: Easy Shrimp Creole
steps: Sauté onion, bell pepper and celery in butter until soft, then add garlic.
Toss the shrimp with 2 teaspoons Creole seasoning.
Add stock, tomatoes, tomato paste, Worcestershire, spices, bay leaves and hot sauce, then simmer.
Sear the shrimp in a separate oiled skillet until lightly pink.
Move the shrimp into the sauce and simmer until cooked through.
Serve over rice topped with green onions.

title: Smothered Chicken Recipe (with Creamy Onion Gravy)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Dredge the chicken in flour seasoned with paprika, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in an ovenproof skillet until golden on both sides, then set it aside.
Cook the onions over medium heat until soft and golden, then add garlic.
Stir in the leftover flour mixture and slowly whisk in broth until it simmers.
Return the chicken skin-side up with thyme and bake until it reaches 165°F.

title: Arroz Con Pollo (Puerto Rican Chicken and Rice)
steps: Coat the chicken in oil and adobo and marinate.
Brown the chicken on both sides and set it aside.
Sauté sofrito, onion and half the pepper, then add garlic, tomato sauce and olives until dry.
Stir in rice, sazón and salt, add stock, and boil until steam holes form.
Lay the chicken on top, cover, and cook on low until it reaches 165°F.
Remove the chicken, stir in peas, fluff the rice, and garnish with pepper and cilantro.

title: Jamaican Curry Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken with thyme, onion, scallions, chili, Maggi, curry powder and spices, and marinate at least 1 hour.
Toast garlic and curry powder in oil, add the chicken, cover, and cook.
Add water mixed with leftover marinade, cover, and boil until the chicken is tender.
Add potatoes, carrot, bouillon and allspice and boil until the potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and serve with rice or roti.

title: Cheese on Toast (Open-Faced Grilled Cheese)
steps: Set the broiler to high with a rack 4–6 inches below it.
Broil the bread until deep golden, flipping once.
Stand the toast upright to cool and crisp.
Cover each toast edge to edge with cheese and drizzle with Worcestershire.
Broil until the cheese is bubbly and golden, then cool briefly.

title: Bangers and Mash (Sausage with Onion Gravy)
steps: Brown the sausages in oil over medium-high heat, turning often until cooked through, then set them aside.
Lower the heat to medium, leaving about 2 tablespoons fat and adding butter if needed.
Sauté onion and garlic until golden.
Stir in the flour and cook, stirring constantly.
Whisk in broth gradually until smooth, add soy sauce, and simmer until thick.
Serve the sausages and gravy with mashed potatoes and peas.

title: Gambas al Ajillo (Spanish Garlic Shrimp)
minor: Dry sherry or dry white wine
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt.
Heat ½ cup olive oil until shimmering, then cook garlic and pepper flakes until just colored.
Add shrimp and paprika and toss until opaque and pink.
Off the heat, stir in sherry, lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with crusty bread for the garlic oil.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Break up cold cooked rice with a fork so no clumps remain.
Beat 3 eggs plain; beat the other 2 with water, paprika and turmeric.
Scramble the plain eggs in a hot oiled wok, then set aside.
Stir-fry onion and bell pepper on high heat.
Add rice and stir-fry, scooping to break up clumps.
Pour spiced egg over rice and toss until coated.
Add peas and season with salt, sugar and pepper.
Fold in scrambled eggs and scallions and serve.

title: Restaurant-Style Chicken Lo Mein

amounts.Noodles: 1 lb fresh lo mein egg noodles

steps: Boil raw noodles, or warm pre-cooked ones, and drain.
Coat sliced chicken with cornstarch, water, oil and oyster sauce.
Stir together the soy sauces, sesame oil, hot water, sugar and pepper.
Sear chicken in a hot oiled wok until cooked, then remove.
Stir-fry garlic, cabbage and carrots, splashing in Shaoxing wine.
Add noodles, chicken and sauce; cover on medium heat.
Toss in bean sprouts and scallions, stir-fry and serve.

title: Cashew Chicken
steps: Toss chicken with cornstarch, water, oil and oyster sauce; mix sauce ingredients separately.
Sear chicken in a smoking-hot oiled wok about a minute per side, then remove.
Fry ginger briefly, then garlic, bell pepper, scallions and water chestnuts.
Splash Shaoxing wine around the edge of the wok.
Add sauce and chicken with juices, bring to a simmer, add cashews.
Stir in cornstarch slurry until thickened; serve with rice.

title: Stir-fried Shrimp and Eggs
steps: Beat room-temperature eggs with salt, white pepper and sesame oil; stir in most scallions.
Poach shrimp briefly in boiling water until pink, drain and add to eggs.
Heat oil in a nearly smoking wok and pour in egg mixture.
Gently fold like scrambled eggs until just set.
Garnish with remaining scallions and serve with rice.

title: Chicken Teriyaki
steps: Microwave soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until sugar dissolves.
Score and flatten thighs to even thickness; season with salt and pepper.
Sear chicken in oil over medium-high, pressing down with a spatula.
Flip, cover and steam on low heat.
Add sauce on medium and spoon over chicken until glossy.
Reduce leftover sauce, slice chicken and drizzle sauce on top.

title: Omurice (Japanese Omelette Rice)
steps: Finely dice onion and cut chicken into 1/2-inch pieces.
Sauté onion in butter until translucent, add chicken and cook through.
Stir in ketchup and Worcestershire until moisture cooks off.
Mix in warm rice and peas, season, and shape into two ovals.
Beat 2 eggs, then cook in butter in a nonstick pan, stirring until half-set.
Set rice in the center and fold egg over it.
Flip onto a plate seam-side down, top with ketchup; repeat.

title: Soboro Don (Ground Chicken Bowl)
steps: Combine ground chicken, ginger, sake, mirin, sugar and soy sauce in a cold saucepan.
Cook on medium-low, stirring constantly into fine crumbles until liquid evaporates and meat glazes.
Beat eggs with sugar and salt in a second cold saucepan.
Cook eggs on medium-low, stirring constantly, until barely set and moist.
Fill bowls with rice; top half with chicken, half with eggs, peas down the middle.

title: Steamed egg side dish (Gyeranjjim)
minor: Salted shrimp sauce (alternative to fish sauce)
steps: Whisk eggs, 1/2 cup water, seasoning and chopped green onions in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave until puffed and set.
Or steam covered over medium heat instead.
Serve hot with rice.

title: Korean rolled omelette (Gyeran-mari)

amounts.Carrots: 1 tbsp minced, or red bell pepper (optional)

steps: Mix eggs with salt, minced onion, pepper and optional minced vegetables.
Oil a nonstick skillet on medium-low and spread a third of the egg thin.
Once the bottom sets, roll the egg to one side of the pan.
Add more egg to the empty space and roll again; repeat until used up.
Brown all sides of the roll on low heat.
Cool briefly, then slice into thick pieces.

title: Dakbokkeumtang (Spicy Braised Chicken Breasts)
steps: Cut chicken into chunks with slits; salt, add milk and refrigerate.
Mix soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, garlic, ginger and black pepper into a paste.
Arrange chicken with apple slices in slits; add paste and 2 1/2 cups water. Cover and cook on medium-high.
Add potatoes, onion and chili; cover and cook on medium.
Add green onions and stir over medium-high until bubbling; serve with rice.

title: Chicken Thai Fried Rice (Khao Pad Gai)
steps: Stir-fry garlic and onion in oil over medium-high until golden.
Add chicken and stir-fry until lightly browned.
Push chicken aside, add oil and scramble the egg into it.
Add rice and break up clumps while tossing.
Season and add vegetables; stir-fry until tender.
Serve with cucumber slices and a lime wedge.

title: Thai Garlic Pepper Chicken (Gai Pad Gratiem)

amounts.Chicken breast: 500 g breast or thigh, sliced 1 cm

steps: Marinate sliced chicken with the sauces and both peppers.
Fry chopped garlic in oil on low until golden; drain and keep the oil.
Stir-fry chicken with sugar in garlic oil over high heat until cooked.
Mix in half the fried garlic and the cilantro stems.
Top with remaining garlic and cilantro; serve with jasmine rice.

title: Thai Omelette (Kai Jeow)
steps: Beat eggs and fish sauce in a pouring jug until fully combined.
Heat 1.5 cm oil in a wok to 190°C; plate the rice.
Pour egg into the hot oil and let it puff up.
Flip with a strainer, cook a few seconds, then flip back.
Slide onto rice, garnish with scallions and serve with Sriracha.

title: Vietnamese Caramelised Pork Bowls
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic and chili.
Add pork and cook until white, breaking it up.
Add brown sugar and fish sauce; leave undisturbed to caramelize, then stir. Repeat twice.
Serve over rice with green onion.

title: Vietnamese Caramel Ginger Chicken
steps: Toss chicken pieces with fish sauce and chili.
Heat oil and brown sugar from cold over medium-high until sugar melts.
Off the heat, add chicken, ginger and shallots; toss.
Return to heat and stir until chicken is white outside.
Add boiling water and simmer rapidly until reduced to a sticky glaze.
Serve with rice and cilantro.

title: Egg Curry (Dhaba Style)
steps: Boil and peel eggs, prick them, and fry in ghee until golden.
Fry whole spices in oil, then sauté onions until golden.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw smell fades.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Stir in spice powders and salt until fragrant.
Add water and simmer until thick, then add eggs and kasuri methi.
Garnish with cilantro; serve with roti or rice.

title: Chicken Curry
steps: Fry whole spices in oil, then add onions and green chilies until golden.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and salt; cook until soft.
Lower heat and stir in yogurt and spice powders until aromatic.
Add chicken and fry until pale, then cover on low.
Add hot water, cover and cook until chicken is tender and gravy thickens.

title: Keema Matar (Ground Beef Curry with Peas)
steps: Fry cumin seeds and onion in oil until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, then beef; cook, breaking into small pieces.
Stir in tomato, chili, yogurt, spices and salt; add a splash of water.
Cover and cook on medium, stirring once.
Add peas and 1/2 cup water; cover and cook.
Add black pepper, garam masala and cilantro; sauté until oil separates.
Rest covered on lowest heat, then finish with lemon or lime juice.

title: Kofta Kebab
steps: Soak wooden skewers and preheat an oiled grill to medium-high.
Pulse onion, garlic and parsley in a food processor until fine.
Add beef, lamb, soaked bread and spices; process until combined.
Divide into 10 portions and press around skewers into 1-inch-thick logs.
Grill until charred and the center reaches 160°F.
Serve with pita, tahini sauce and tomato.

title: Lebanese Lentil Soup (Shorbet Adas)
steps: Soften onion in olive oil over medium heat, then add garlic.
Stir in lentils, rice, carrot, spices, salt and pepper until fragrant.
Add broth, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until tender.
Stir in lemon juice and blend partly if you like.
Garnish with green onions and parsley.

title: Strapatsada (Greek Tomato Feta Scrambled Eggs)
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl.
Sauté tomatoes in olive oil over medium heat until soft and browned.
Add garlic for a minute, then stir in tomato paste and water and simmer.
Lower heat, pour in eggs and stir gently until soft curds form.
Take off heat, top with feta and parsley, serve with bread.

title: Avgolemono Soup
steps: Sauté carrots, celery, green onions and garlic in olive oil.
Add broth and bay leaves, bring to a boil, then add rice.
Simmer until rice is tender, then stir in shredded chicken.
Whisk eggs with lemon juice; slowly whisk in two ladles of hot broth to temper.
Stir egg-lemon mixture into soup and remove from heat immediately; garnish with parsley.

title: Spanakorizo (Greek Spinach Rice)
steps: Rinse rice and soak it in water.
Sauté onion in olive oil until golden.
Add spinach, lemon juice, garlic, tomato paste, salt and pepper; cook until wilted, then add herbs.
Add drained rice and 1 1/2 cups warm water; boil briefly.
Cover on low heat until rice is tender.
Rest covered, fluff, and top with feta.

title: Easy Greek Bean Soup (Fasolada)
steps: Sauté onion with salt and pepper in olive oil.
Add garlic, celery, bay leaf and oregano; cook.
Add broth, beans and spices; boil, then simmer covered.
Blend 2 cups of soup and return it to the pot; simmer briefly.
Stir in olive oil, lemon zest, juice and parsley; serve with bread.

title: Croque Monsieur

amounts.Gruyere: 8 slices Swiss or Gruyere (165g) + 1/2 cup shredded Gruyere

steps: Make a butter-flour roux, whisk in warm milk and cream until thick béchamel.
Spread béchamel on bread; layer cheese, mustard, ham and more cheese.
Pan-fry sandwiches in butter until golden on both sides.
Top with remaining béchamel, Gruyere and Parmesan.
Bake at 200°C/390°F, then broil until golden.

title: Chicken Fricassée (Quick French Chicken Stew)
steps: Season chicken and brown in butter, thighs skin-side first; remove.
Sauté mushrooms, onion, bay and thyme; add garlic, then flour.
Add wine and stock, scraping up browned bits.
Return chicken skin-side up; simmer covered.
Uncover and simmer until chicken reaches 75°C/167°F.
Remove chicken, stir in cream until simmering, return chicken and add parsley.

title: Potatoes au Gratin (Dauphinoise)
steps: Mix melted butter, cream and garlic; heat oven to 180°C/350°F.
Peel potatoes and slice 3mm thick.
Layer potatoes, cream mixture, seasoning and cheese in three layers.
Cover with foil and bake until potatoes are tender.
Uncover, top with cheese and bake until golden.
Rest before serving.

title: One Pan Chicken and Rice
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oil, mustard, garlic and herbs.
Sear thighs in an ovenproof skillet until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion, then add spinach, garlic, oregano and leftover marinade.
Stir in rice, add stock and bring to a simmer.
Top with chicken, cover and bake at 350°F.
Uncover and bake until thighs reach 165°F; rest before serving.

title: One Pan Shrimp and Rice

amounts.Frozen shrimp: scant 1 pound large, thawed and peeled

steps: Rinse and soak rice.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, garlic, peas and parsley in olive oil; add spices.
Add drained rice, salt and water; boil until liquid reduces by half.
Cover and simmer on low until rice is tender.
Nestle shrimp into rice, cover and cook until pink.

title: Easy Mediterranean-Style Shrimp Stew
steps: Heat oven to 375°F.
Sauté onion, bell pepper and garlic in olive oil; add spices until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and water; simmer.
Move to a baking dish and stir in shrimp and parsley.
Cover and bake, then broil briefly until shrimp are pink.

title: Ful Medames (Egyptian Fava Beans)
steps: Sauté sliced onion in olive oil until caramelized.
Add garlic, cumin, salt and pepper.
Add drained beans and water; simmer until reduced.
Cool slightly and blend until chunky.
Serve with tomatoes, cucumber and pita.

title: Lebanese Hashweh Rice (Spiced Beef and Rice)
steps: Rinse and soak rice.
Sauté onion in oil and butter, then brown beef with half the spices.
Stir in drained rice and remaining spices; add stock and boil without stirring.
Cover tightly and cook on low.
Rest covered, then fluff.
Toast nuts in oil and butter; scatter over rice with parsley.

title: Perfect Menemen (Turkish Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes)
steps: Sauté onion and green pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste and seasonings; cook.
Push vegetables aside, lower heat and add beaten eggs; cook gently until just set.
Fold vegetables into eggs, drizzle with oil, serve with bread.

title: One Pot Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Mix the Cajun seasoning and coat cubed chicken.
Sauté chicken in oil and butter until browned; add onion.
Stir in pasta, tomatoes with juices and broth.
Cover and simmer, stirring, until pasta is tender.
Melt in cream cheese and top with green onions.

title: Dirty Rice (Classic Cajun, One-Pot)
steps: Sauté bell pepper, onion and celery in oil until soft; add garlic.
Add the meat and brown it, breaking it up.
Stir in rice, broth and seasonings; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer until rice is tender.
Remove bay leaf, fluff and garnish with herbs.

title: Brazilian-Style Rice
steps: Bring water to a boil in a separate pot.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until translucent.
Add washed rice and fry until it starts to clump.
Add boiling water and salt; cover and cook on lowest heat.
Rest covered, then fluff with a fork.

title: Brazilian Chicken Stroganoff
steps: Season cubed chicken with salt and pepper.
Brown chicken in butter over medium-high heat.
Add onion until translucent, then garlic until fragrant.
Stir in tomato sauce and ketchup; simmer.
Add cream and simmer uncovered; garnish with parsley and serve with rice.

title: Atakilt Wat (Ethiopian Cabbage, Potato and Carrots)
steps: Cook onion, garlic, ginger and chili in oil.
Add the spices and cook to bloom.
Stir in carrots and potatoes, then cabbage and salt; cover and cook.
Add remaining oil and salt, splash of water if dry; cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Kik Alicha (Ethiopian Split Pea Stew)
steps: Rinse split peas, then boil in water until soft, uncovering near the end.
Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger, then turmeric.
Stir onion mixture into peas and simmer gently, adding water as needed.
Season to taste and serve warm.

title: Enqulal Firfir (Ethiopian Scrambled Eggs)
steps: Mix teff and plain flour, salt, nigella, oil and water into a thick dough.
Cook the kita in a nonstick pan covered, flip and cook again.
Meanwhile sauté onion, garlic and tomato; stir in tomato paste.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir constantly until cooked.
Finish with chilli and coriander; serve with kita for scooping.
